name: Jay Montoya
life: “I still remember my first wages just covering the price of a textbook.” Friday often includes a stop at the entrance to the Wash House, where Jay stops for local notices even on a day without a load to wash.
voice: I received this scholarship years ago. I returned the typo letter with one month's pay enclosed.
appearance: Jay has a straight nose and deep-set eyes. Look for short sandy hair and a marked widow's peak. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a moss-green cardigan with a pocket notebook shaped by years of sitting on it. In conversation Jay looks at people's hands before looking at what they carry.
personality: Jay feels a room through sound. A door slammed in high spirits can produce the same instant startle as an angry one, and it takes a little while to hear what actually follows.
agenda: To add a month's pay to the scholarship fund.
family: Kira Ortiz is Jay’s older cousin. Jay gets to change the plan. Kira offers the first invitation. They learned that a promise to visit is easier to keep when changing a time does not count as letting down the whole family. Asked about *The sheltered corner*, Kira says, “I used to see my daughter's kitchen from the shelter.”
connections: Elena Mehta. Two new contributions give the trust reason to revise the shorthand on the forms.
